sections.title: Special rules and legal basis (Aosta Valley)

rows.label: Special rules (disposizioni particolari)
rows.value: For 2026, taxpayers with total income up to €15,000 are exempt. Above €15,000 the ordinary rate applies to the whole taxable income.
